en.content: In the reaction of potassium dichromate, potassium chloride and sulfuric acid (conc.), the oxidation state of the chromium in the product is _________.

This reaction is called chromyl chloride test.

hi.explanation:
इस अभिक्रिया को क्रोमिल क्लोराइड परीक्षण कहते हैं।
